description: Source code for the multiplayer lobby interface of the Wesnoth game, including classes for game browsing, lobby management, and sorting.

classes.name: mp::gamebrowser
classes.description: Class for displaying and interacting with a list of multiplayer games.

classes.name: mp::lobby
classes.description: Class managing the multiplayer lobby interface, including game list and user actions.

classes.name: mp::lobby_sorter
classes.description: Class for sorting game entries in the lobby based on different columns.

methods.name: games_menu_heading
methods.description: Generates the header string for the games menu.

methods.name: gamebrowser::set_inner_location
methods.description: Sets the visible area of the game list based on a rectangle.

methods.name: gamebrowser::scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the game list to a specified position.

methods.name: gamebrowser::get_item_rect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for a specific game item.

methods.name: gamebrowser::draw
methods.description: Handles drawing the game list UI.

methods.name: gamebrowser::draw_contents
methods.description: Draws the contents of the game list.

methods.name: gamebrowser::draw_item
methods.description: Draws a single game item in the list.

methods.name: gamebrowser::handle_event
methods.description: Handles user input events for the game list.

methods.name: gamebrowser::set_game_items
methods.description: Populates the game list with data from configuration.

methods.name: lobby::gamelist_updated
methods.description: Updates the game list UI when the list changes.

methods.name: lobby::process_event
methods.description: Processes user actions like join, observe, create, or quit game.

methods.name: lobby::process_network_data
methods.description: Handles incoming network data related to the lobby.
